subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Confidential
solution:
The correct answer is: **Secret**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Confidential"** means intended to be kept secret or private. (गोपनीय)

 
 
• **Example:** The document contains **confidential **information about the company’s future plans.
 
 
 
• **"Secret"** refers to something that is meant to be kept unknown or unseen by others. (गुप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The **secret **recipe for the cake has been passed down through generations.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is Secret.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Limited** (सीमित): Restricted in size, amount, or extent.

 
 
• **Example:** The offer is available for a **limited **time only.
 
 
 
• **Open source** (मुक्त स्रोत): Software for which the original source code is made freely available and may be redistributed and modified.
 
 
• **Example:** Linux is an **open source** operating system.
 
 
 
• **Public** (सार्वजनिक): Concerning or affecting all or most of the people in a community or country.
 
 
• **Example:** The **public** library is open to everyone.
